text:
The torch is in the blue drawer: Tariq moved it there, and the later text message was intended to mislead.

ANSWER: B

Wanjiru saw the torch put in the grey locker and later received messages saying it was there. She receives no newer information, so she still thinks it is in the grey locker.

ANSWER: C

The latest booking change is Wanjiru’s move to Room Dogwood in step 8. Oksana’s message does not change the booking.

ANSWER: C

Tariq last saw the torch put in the grey locker before he left the garage. He missed the later move to the black trunk and Bruno’s announcement. When Tariq returns, he moves the torch to the blue drawer, so he knows it is there.

ANSWER: B
ANSWER: B

Amara’s latest information is Oksana’s direct message saying the workshop is in Room Fir. Amara believes what she is told, so she thinks it is in Room Fir.

ANSWER: B
ANSWER: A

Wanjiru’s latest information is that the torch is in the grey locker. She hears nothing about the later moves, so she opens the grey locker first.

ANSWER: C

Amara last learned that the workshop was in Room Birch, then believed Oksana’s newer message that it was in Room Fir. Answering honestly, she says Room Fir.

ANSWER: B

Tariq moved the torch to the blue drawer, but Bruno didn’t see that. Bruno’s latest information is Tariq’s message saying the torch is in the white cabinet, and he believes it. So Bruno will open the white cabinet first.

ANSWER: D

Wanjiru hears Amara move the workshop to Room Birch, so she thinks Amara now believes it is booked there. Wanjiru is not on the later call when it moves back to Dogwood, and she doesn’t learn about Oksana’s message.

ANSWER: C

Amara hears herself move the workshop to Birch at step 7, so Oksana knows Amara believes it is in Birch. But Oksana later sends Amara a message saying Fir, and knows Amara reads it at once. Amara therefore thinks Oksana thinks she believes it is in Fir.

ANSWER: D

Wanjiru expects Amara to say Room Birch: Wanjiru knows Amara moved the workshop there, but doesn’t know about the later change or Oksana’s private message.

ANSWER: A

Ines moves the marble from the green cupboard to the red box, and no later event moves it again. So it ends up in the red box.

ANSWER: B

Wanjiru hears Oksana read that the booking is in Dogwood, then hears Amara change it to Birch and later hears Wanjiru change it back to Dogwood while Oksana is on the call. So Wanjiru thinks Oksana thinks it is booked in Dogwood. Oksana’s final private message to Amara does not change Wanjiru’s belief.

ANSWER: D

Rania hears Bruno say the torch is in the black trunk. She doesn’t know what Tariq’s private message says, so she still thinks Bruno thinks it is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

Chidi saw Mirela move the marble to the green cupboard. He was away when Ines moved it, and received no later information about its location. He therefore thinks it is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: B

Ines saw that the marble was in the green cupboard, then moved it herself to the red box. She therefore thinks it is in the red box.

ANSWER: D

Chidi saw Zoltan reveal the marble in the green cupboard before he left. He was away when Ines moved it to the red box, and nobody told him about that move. So he opens the green cupboard first.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan last learned that the marble was in the wooden chest from Amara’s text. He does not see Ines move it afterward, and no later information updates his belief about the marble. So he waits beside the wooden chest.

ANSWER: A

At event 8, Xavier, Dalia and Wanjiru are all on the call. Wanjiru moves the workshop to Room Dogwood, so Xavier believes it is in Dogwood. Xavier also believes Dalia hears Wanjiru, and that Dalia knows Wanjiru hears Xavier. The later message is sent only to Amara, so it does not change Xavier’s belief.

ANSWER: B

On the call where Amara moves the workshop to Birch, both Oksana and Dalia are present. Amara therefore thinks Oksana heard Dalia hear the change, so she thinks Oksana thinks Dalia thinks Birch. Amara doesn’t know about the later call where Wanjiru moves it to Dogwood, and Oksana’s message says nothing about what Dalia thinks.

ANSWER: C

Chidi saw Zoltan reveal the marble in the green cupboard, but he was away when Ines moved it to the red box. Ines knows this, so she thinks Chidi still thinks it is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: C

Zoltan saw Mirela move the marble to the green cupboard, so he believes Mirela thinks it is there. Amara’s later message changes Zoltan’s belief about the marble’s location, but doesn’t tell him what Mirela thinks.

ANSWER: B

Wanjiru last learned from Bruno’s text that the torch was in the grey locker, and she missed his later announcement that it was in the black trunk. Bruno knows she read his text, so he thinks she believes it is in the grey locker. His later belief change from Tariq’s misleading text is unknown to Wanjiru and does not change that nested belief.

ANSWER: D

Mirela thinks Ines saw Chidi learn that the marble was in the green cupboard. Ines then moved it while Chidi was away, so Mirela thinks Ines believes Chidi still thinks it is there.

ANSWER: A

Amara believes the workshop is in Room Fir because of Oksana’s message. She can tell that Xavier, Wanjiru, and Dalia heard her move it to Birch, but Oksana’s message leads her to believe Oksana thinks it is in Fir.

ANSWER: Xavier, Wanjiru, Dalia

The offsite is moved to Graz, then later moved to Turin. The misleading message saying Porto does not change its location.

ANSWER: D

Tariq knows Rania and Xavier saw him move the torch to the blue drawer, so he thinks they share his view. Wanjiru last saw it in the blue drawer before leaving; Tariq doesn’t know about the private texts she received. Bruno, however, reads Tariq’s message and believes the torch is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: Bruno

Nadim hears Hana set the offsite to Ghent, then hears Xavier move it to Graz. He also secretly listens to the later call where Hana says it is in Graz. He is not on the final call, so he does not learn that it moves to Turin.

ANSWER: C

Amara puts the token in the flat tin, and Ines sees her do it. Chidi is present and sees both the move and Ines witnessing it, so Ines thinks Chidi thinks she knows Amara thinks the token is in the flat tin.

ANSWER: B

Viktor hears Hana move the offsite to Turin on the final call, so he thinks it is in Turin.

ANSWER: B

Tariq last saw the torch in the grey locker before he and Xavier left. Tariq missed Bruno’s move to the black trunk and his announcement, so Xavier thinks Tariq still believes Bruno thinks it is in the grey locker. Xavier cannot read Tariq’s private text to Bruno.

ANSWER: C

Nadim believes the offsite is in Graz. He heard the move to Graz on the call and later heard Hana confirm it; he did not learn about the move to Turin.

ANSWER: D

Tariq saw the torch put in the grey locker before he left. He missed Bruno moving it to the black trunk and announcing that change. Bruno knows Rania saw Tariq leave and knows Xavier heard the announcement while Tariq was away, so Bruno thinks Rania thinks Xavier thinks Tariq still believes it is in the grey locker. Bruno doesn’t know about the later move to the blue drawer, and Tariq’s private text doesn’t tell Rania about it.

ANSWER: B
ANSWER: C

Nadim heard the move to Graz on the call with Xavier, Viktor, and himself. Viktor believes Nadim missed the later call and never learned about the move to Turin, so Viktor thinks Nadim still believes the offsite is in Graz.

ANSWER: D

Hana knows Nadim heard Ghent on the first call. She doesn’t know he heard her say Graz or that he was on the call where Xavier moved the offsite, and Nadim missed the later change to Turin. So Hana expects him to answer **Ghent**.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan believes the marble is in the wooden chest because of Amara’s text. As far as he can tell, Ines, Mirela and Chidi saw the marble in the green cupboard, so he thinks they believe it is there. He thinks Amara shares his view, based on her text.

ANSWER: Ines, Mirela, Chidi

The padlock is in the white cabinet when Quinn opens the containers. Afterward, Goran moves it to the wooden chest, and no later move is described. So it is really in the wooden chest.

ANSWER: A

Nadim heard Xavier move the offsite to Graz on the second call. Xavier and Viktor both know Nadim heard it. Xavier doesn’t know Nadim secretly listened to the later call, and Nadim missed the final move to Turin, so Viktor thinks Xavier still thinks Nadim believes the offsite is in Graz.

ANSWER: B

Nadim last learns that the padlock is in the white cabinet from Goran’s text. He doesn’t see the later events in the cellar, so he still thinks it is there.

ANSWER: C

At call 4, Xavier, Viktor, and Hana all hear Viktor book the client workshop in Room Elm. Since each can see the others on the call, Xavier believes Viktor heard Hana hear it, and so on through the nested beliefs. Later events do not change the workshop room.

ANSWER: B

Viktor sees Goran move the padlock to the wooden chest, so he thinks it is there.

ANSWER: C

Nadim’s latest information is Goran’s text saying the padlock is in the white cabinet. He doesn’t see the later events, so he opens the white cabinet first.

ANSWER: D

Xavier knows Nadim was on the call where Ghent was set, but not on the later calls where Hana said Graz or moved the offsite to Turin. Xavier therefore thinks Nadim still believes Hana thinks the offsite is in Ghent.

ANSWER: C

Dalia knows Amara and Oksana were both on the call where Amara moved the workshop to Birch, but Amara was not on the later call where Wanjiru moved it back to Dogwood. Dalia does not know about Oksana’s private message to Amara. So Dalia thinks Oksana believes Amara thinks Oksana believes the room is Birch.

ANSWER: C

Rania reads Xavier’s message telling Wanjiru that the torch is in the grey locker, so Rania thinks Wanjiru thinks it is in the grey locker. Bruno sees Rania read the message, so he thinks Rania has that belief. Tariq’s later misleading message changes Bruno’s own belief, not this nested belief.

ANSWER: B

Mirela thinks Ines noticed the marble move to the green cupboard. So Mirela thinks Ines believes Amara knows Zoltan saw it there. Ines doesn’t know about Amara’s private message, and believes Zoltan’s latest information is still that the marble is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan learns from Mirela that the token is in the flat tin, but he receives no information that Ines saw the token or learned where it was. He thinks Ines has no idea where it is.

ANSWER: E

Bruno’s latest information about Goran’s belief came from Goran’s text saying the padlock was in the leather bag. Viktor’s later text tells Bruno where the padlock is, but not what Goran thinks.

ANSWER: B

Viktor knows Quinn missed Goran’s final move to the wooden chest, but he also knows Goran doesn’t realize she missed it. So Viktor thinks Goran believes Quinn saw the move and now thinks the padlock is in the wooden chest.

ANSWER: D

The final reassignment is in step 12, when Jonas assigns the Marlow account to the Osaka office. The messages do not change the account assignment.

ANSWER: C

Nadim knows that Ines received his message and Viktor told him the room, so he can tell they both share his view. He has no indication that Xavier or Hana knows the room, so he messages them.

ANSWER: Xavier, Hana

Viktor knows Bruno read his text saying the padlock was in the white cabinet. Viktor sees Goran move it afterward, but Bruno doesn’t learn about that move.

ANSWER: B

Dalia believes Osaka after secretly listening to the account list being read. Jonas’s and Goran’s later messages replace that belief with Nairobi, then Lisbon. Chidi’s message later tells her Nairobi, so that is what she believes at the end.

ANSWER: B

Uma’s latest information is from the final call, where she hears Jonas reassign the account to Osaka.

ANSWER: B

Dalia’s latest information is Chidi’s direct message saying the account is with the Nairobi office. She doesn’t learn about the later reassignment to Osaka, so she answers Nairobi.

ANSWER: C

Hana actually heard Viktor book the workshop in Room Elm, but Nadim wasn’t on that call and isn’t told that Hana heard it. He learns Elm from Viktor, but nothing tells him Hana knows the room. So Nadim thinks Hana has no idea.

ANSWER: E

Uma hears Jonas reassign the account to Nairobi on call 9, so she thinks Jonas believes it is with Nairobi. She misses the later call where he reassigns it to Osaka and learns nothing about that change.

ANSWER: D

Quinn missed Goran’s final move, so Quinn still thinks the padlock is in the white cabinet. But Quinn knows Nadim and Viktor both left before the later moves, after seeing Nadim put the padlock in the leather bag. Quinn therefore thinks Nadim thinks Viktor believes Nadim thinks it is in the leather bag.

ANSWER: A

Mirela saw both Amara and Zoltan present when the marble was moved to the green cupboard. She cannot read Amara’s private text, so she doesn’t know it changed what Amara thinks Zoltan believes. She therefore thinks Amara thinks Zoltan believes the marble is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: D

Dalia believes Goran’s direct message that the account is with Lisbon. She receives no later information from Goran that changes what she thinks he believes.

ANSWER: D

The compass is moved from the striped tin to the flat tin, back to the striped tin, and finally to the round tin.

ANSWER: D

Viktor believes Nadim missed the later calls and was not told about Viktor’s private message to Hana. From Viktor’s perspective, Nadim knows Hana set Ghent, but knows the move to Graz happened while Hana was absent. So Viktor attributes to Nadim the belief that Viktor thinks Hana still thinks Ghent.

ANSWER: A
ANSWER: A

Viktor believes Bruno still thinks the padlock is in the white cabinet, because Bruno received no later update. Viktor also believes Bruno thinks Viktor believes that, since Viktor sent Bruno the message saying it was in the white cabinet. The later move to the wooden chest changes Viktor’s own belief, but Bruno does not know about it.

ANSWER: A

Bruno sees himself move the compass to the round tin, so he thinks it is there.

ANSWER: A

Goran actually believes the account is with Nairobi: he heard the reassignment on call 9. But Dalia doesn’t know Goran was on that call. The latest office Goran told her was Lisbon, so Dalia expects him to say Lisbon.

ANSWER: B

Uma last saw herself move the compass into the flat tin. She missed Bruno moving it afterward and wasn’t told about the later moves, so she believes it is still in the flat tin.

ANSWER: C

Bruno’s last direct information about Goran’s belief is Goran’s text saying the padlock was in the leather bag. Viktor’s later text updates Bruno about the padlock’s location at that time, but doesn’t tell him what Goran knows. Bruno also doesn’t know Goran’s final move to the wooden chest. So Bruno should wait by the leather bag.

ANSWER: A

Bruno saw Uma put the compass in the flat tin. When he moved it to the striped tin, he believed Uma had noticed and updated her belief. He later moved it to the round tin while Uma was away, so he thinks she still believes it is in the striped tin.

ANSWER: B

At event 9, Jonas and Goran both hear that the account is reassigned to Nairobi. Goran gets no later information, and he is absent from the final call, so Jonas thinks Goran still believes the account is with Nairobi. Uma hears both calls and knows Jonas was on them too, so she thinks Jonas thinks Goran thinks it is with Nairobi.

ANSWER: C

Nadim believes the padlock is in the white cabinet, based on Goran’s text. As far as Nadim can tell, Goran shares that view. Bruno received Nadim’s text saying leather bag, and Quinn and Viktor saw Nadim put it there, so Nadim thinks those three believe it is in the leather bag.

ANSWER: Bruno, Quinn, Viktor

Uma believes the compass is in the flat tin: she put it there, missed Bruno moving it to the striped tin, and was away when he moved it again. Bruno doesn’t realize she missed his move to the striped tin, so he expects her to look there first.

ANSWER: C

Farah saw Uma watch the stopwatch move into the black trunk, so Farah thinks Uma believes it is there. The later messages tell Farah about the canvas sack, but not what Uma thinks.

ANSWER: B

The supplier is switched to Sablewood, then Ironbridge, and finally Brightwater. So the real supplier at the end is Brightwater.

ANSWER: B

Farah leaves before the compass is put in the striped tin. She receives no information about the compass afterward, so she has no idea where it is.

ANSWER: E

Dalia’s view at the end is Nairobi: Chidi tells her Nairobi, and she then tells Uma Nairobi. She believes Jonas also thinks Nairobi from his message, but thinks Goran believes Lisbon from his message. So only Goran seems to hold a different view.

ANSWER: Goran

Bruno learns that Soren picked Ironbridge, then later hears the supplier switched to Sablewood on a call. He is not on the calls where Mirela changes it afterward, so he still thinks it is Sablewood.

ANSWER: C

Zoltan learns that the account is with Lisbon on the first call. He misses the later changes until calls 11 and 12, where he hears it reassigned first to Nairobi and then to Osaka. The latest information he hears is Osaka.

ANSWER: D

Bruno last learned about the supplier when he switched it to Sablewood on a call. He wasn’t on the later calls where Mirela changed it, so he believes the supplier is Sablewood.

ANSWER: A

Uma believes Rania last saw the compass in the striped tin, and believes Bruno knows Rania was absent when it was moved. So Uma thinks Bruno thinks Rania still believes it is in the striped tin.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan knows Rania heard the Marlow account was assigned to Lisbon on the first call. He does not learn about her later information, so he thinks she still believes it is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: D

Bruno heard Soren pick Ironbridge, then switched the supplier to Sablewood himself. Soren was on that call, so he thinks Bruno believes the supplier is Sablewood. Soren learns of no later supplier changes that might alter Bruno’s belief.

ANSWER: C

Rania last learned that the Marlow account was with the Osaka office, from Mirela’s message. She heard no later updates, so she will honestly answer Osaka. Zoltan also heard the final reassignment to Osaka.

ANSWER: D

Nadim knows Bruno last saw the padlock in the wicker basket before leaving. Nadim doesn’t know the contents of Goran’s private text to Bruno, so he has no information that would make him think Goran updated his view of Bruno’s belief.

ANSWER: C

Zoltan heard Soren reassign the account to Osaka while both were on the call. Soren also saw Zoltan on the call and knew he heard the reassignment, so Zoltan thinks Soren thinks he believes the account is with Osaka.

ANSWER: A

Zoltan was not on any call where the packaging supplier was set or changed, and nobody told him the supplier. So he has no idea which company it is.

ANSWER: E

The last move is Bruno putting the compass in the wicker basket, so that is where it really is.

ANSWER: D

Goran hears Jonas reassign the account to Nairobi on call 9, so he believes it is with Nairobi. Chidi is on that call and believes Goran heard the reassignment, so Chidi thinks Goran believes it is with Nairobi.

On call 12, Goran is absent. Uma sees that, and believes Chidi also sees it; she therefore thinks Chidi still believes Goran thinks the account is with Nairobi. Chidi believes Uma thinks this too. His missing the reassignment on that call does not change what he thinks Goran knows.

ANSWER: B

Viktor believes the stopwatch is in the canvas sack. He thinks Rania and Bruno also believe it is there, and he knows his text has told Farah the same. He believes Uma still thinks it is in the black trunk, since he does not know she later saw Rania move it there.

ANSWER: Uma

Emeka’s latest observed location is the grey locker. He does not see Bruno move the compass after Uma returns.

ANSWER: A

Oksana last sees Bruno move the compass to the wicker basket, so she thinks it is there.

ANSWER: D

When Rania texts Viktor, she believes the compass is in the striped tin, and she knows he reads the message. She therefore thinks Viktor believes it is striped. After seeing Bruno move it to the round tin, Rania has no reason to think Viktor learned about that change; she thinks Viktor still believes the compass is striped and that she believes his view is striped.

ANSWER: A

Emeka’s latest observed location is the grey locker: he watches Bruno put the compass there. He does not see the final move to the wicker basket, so he goes to the grey locker first.

ANSWER: B

Uma last saw herself put the compass in the flat tin. She missed Bruno’s move to the striped tin and was gone before he moved it to the round tin. So she believes it is flat, and believes Bruno thinks it is flat; in her view, Bruno also thinks she believes his location-belief is flat.

ANSWER: C

Zoltan knows Mirela and Soren heard the account move to Osaka. He has no information about later updates reaching Bruno or Rania, so as far as he can tell they still believe the office is Lisbon.

ANSWER: Bruno, Rania

Farah reads Rania’s message saying the stopwatch is in the canvas sack. Rania believes Bruno saw her move it there, so Farah thinks Rania thinks Bruno believes it is there. Farah does not learn about Rania’s later move to the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

Emeka’s latest information is seeing Bruno move the compass to the grey locker. He doesn’t see the final move to the wicker basket, so he will open the grey locker first.

ANSWER: A

Oksana believes Emeka read her text saying the compass was in the grey locker. She doesn’t know he later watched the compass move, so she thinks his latest information is that it is in the grey locker.

ANSWER: D

Rania last saw Soren and Mirela learn about the account’s move to Denver together, so she thinks Soren thinks it is in Denver. Mirela’s message claims Osaka, but doesn’t say what Soren thinks; Rania misses the later calls.

ANSWER: A

The release is really set for Friday: Jonas changes it to Friday in the final event.

ANSWER: D

When Viktor returns, Bruno moves the compass to the grey locker, and later moves it to the wicker basket. Both Viktor and Bruno see the final move, so Bruno thinks Viktor thinks the compass is in the wicker basket. Uma sees them both present for that move, so she thinks this too.

ANSWER: B

Nadim learns Friday from Farah’s message in step 8. In step 10, he secretly listens as Yara reads out that the release is set for Thursday, so he believes Thursday.

ANSWER: C

Nadim learns Thursday when he secretly listens to Yara read the release calendar on the call. That is newer than Farah’s message saying Friday. He learns nothing about the later changes, so he honestly answers Thursday.

ANSWER: C

Rania saw Zoltan hear the Lisbon assignment on the first call, then saw him absent when the account was reassigned to Denver. Soren and Mirela were on both calls, so Rania thinks Soren thinks Mirela thinks Zoltan still thinks Lisbon. The later private message to Rania does not tell Soren anything.

ANSWER: A

Hana’s latest information is Farah’s direct message saying the release is set for Friday. She learns nothing about the later changes.

ANSWER: A

Oksana thinks Uma still believes the compass is in the grey locker, because Uma left before Oksana’s later moves. Emeka watches those moves, but not Uma’s return and the final move to the wicker basket, so he thinks Oksana’s belief about Uma remains unchanged.

ANSWER: B

When Emeka leaves, he has seen the compass moved to the green cupboard, so Uma thinks that is where he believes it is. The later text messages are private, and she does not know Emeka is watching through the window.

ANSWER: C

Rania believes Mirela’s message that the account is with Osaka, and believes Mirela thinks that too. Mirela knows Rania read the message, so Mirela thinks Rania holds that belief. Rania in turn thinks Mirela knows this. The later calls leave Mirela’s own belief at Osaka, and Rania does not hear about them.

ANSWER: A

Yara knows Nadim was on the call where Jonas set the release for Thursday. She sees Nadim is absent from the later calls, and she doesn’t know about Farah’s private message or Nadim secretly listening to the calendar readout. So she thinks Nadim’s latest information is Thursday.

ANSWER: C

Uma does not see the private messages between Dalia and Chidi, so she does not know that Chidi told Dalia he believed the account was in Nairobi. Dalia’s message to Uma tells her only that Dalia believes the account is in Nairobi; it does not tell her what Dalia thinks Chidi believes. From the information Uma can attribute to Dalia and Chidi together, she thinks Dalia believes Chidi thinks the account is in Osaka.

ANSWER: D

Jonas moves the brooch from the flat tin to the tall tin, and it is not moved afterward. So it is really in the tall tin.

ANSWER: D

O believes Emeka’s latest information is the message she sent saying the compass was in the grey locker. She therefore thinks Emeka believes she thinks his belief is that it’s in the grey locker. Emeka’s last view through the window also showed Bruno moving it to the grey locker, so the nested belief is grey.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru watches Tariq open the tins and sees the brooch in the flat tin. She does not see Tariq move it to the tall tin afterward, so she still thinks it is in the flat tin.

ANSWER: B

At event 9, Farah sees Jonas set the release to Thursday while Hana is on the call, so she thinks Jonas believes Hana learned it was Thursday. Hana is absent when Jonas sets it to Friday at event 11. Farah later messages Hana that it is Friday, but she does not know Jonas secretly reads that message. And at event 13, Hana is absent when Farah sets it to Wednesday. So Farah continues to think Jonas believes Hana thinks the release is set for Thursday.

ANSWER: D

Hana’s last known update that Yara heard was Yara reading the calendar as Thursday on the call in step 10. Hana does not know about Yara hearing Friday in step 11, and Farah’s message in step 12 does not tell her what Yara thinks. So Hana thinks Yara thinks the release is set for Thursday.

ANSWER: B

Hana last knows that Yara heard the calendar read “Thursday” on call 10. Hana wasn’t on call 11 and doesn’t know about Yara’s later observation; Farah’s private message to Hana doesn’t tell her what Yara knows. So Hana expects Yara to say Thursday.

ANSWER: A

Ines last saw Jonas move the torch to the canvas sack. She was outside when the later events happened, and no one told her the torch had moved.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru sees the brooch in the flat tin when Tariq opens the tins. She is not described as seeing Tariq move it to the tall tin afterward, so she still believes it is in the flat tin and opens that first.

ANSWER: A

Yara’s own view is Monday, based on secretly watching Jonas set it to Monday at step 14. She does not know Jonas later changed it to Friday.

From what Yara can tell, Jonas also believes Monday. She thinks Farah believes Wednesday, Nadim believes Thursday, and Hana believes Thursday, so she messages those three.

ANSWER: Farah, Nadim, Hana

Tariq sees Jonas move the brooch to the flat tin, sees the tins opened to show it there, and then sees the brooch moved to the tall tin. Tariq therefore thinks Jonas believes the brooch is in the tall tin.

ANSWER: D

At the end, Uma thinks Goran thinks Nairobi: they both heard the reassignment on call 9, and Goran wasn’t on call 12. But Uma thinks Dalia’s view is still based on call 2, where Dalia and Goran heard Osaka and nobody realized Uma missed it. Dalia’s later message to Uma gives no information about what Goran knows, and Dalia wasn’t on the calls that updated his view.

So Uma thinks Dalia thinks Uma thinks Goran thinks the account is with Osaka.

ANSWER: D

At step 11, both Farah and Yara hear Jonas set the release to Friday, so Yara thinks Farah believes Yara thinks Jonas believes it is Friday. Farah’s later call with Jonas excludes Yara, and Yara’s later observation of Jonas is secret, so neither changes what Yara thinks Farah believes Yara knows.

ANSWER: C

Wanjiru saw the brooch revealed in the copper tin before she left. Ines sees Wanjiru leave before the later changes, and doesn’t know Wanjiru watches through the window, so Ines still thinks Wanjiru believes the brooch is in the copper tin.

ANSWER: B

The Marlow account was reassigned to Denver in step 7, and there are no later changes to it. So it really has the Denver office.

ANSWER: A
ANSWER: D

Emeka’s latest observed move is Bruno putting the compass in the grey locker. He sees Bruno, Oksana and Viktor there for that move, so he thinks they share his view. He has no such update about Uma, so she gets a note.

ANSWER: Uma

Nadim hears the calendar read “Thursday” on call 10, and learns no later update, so he thinks the release is set for Thursday. Yara doesn’t know he was listening, but she saw him set it to Thursday on call 4 and has no reason to think he learned otherwise. Hana also saw Nadim set it to Thursday on call 1 and, on call 10, sees that he isn’t on the call. So Hana thinks Yara thinks Nadim believes it is Thursday.
